data.text:
Thanks for welcoming me. Over dinner, I’d like to propose a one-month higher-harvest trial: John and Kate, each choose **15 tons this month**, and Jack and Emma, I’d encourage you to join them at **15 tons each**. I’ll catch **zero** for my first month, so this isn’t a bid for a bigger personal share.

That gives each participating fisherman $15,000 instead of $10,000. If all four participate, we’ll harvest 60 tons, leave 40, and start next month with 80 after reproduction—not a full lake, so this isn’t something we can repeat indefinitely. We’d need to reduce our combined harvest to 30 tons next month to restore the lake to 100.

John and Kate, will you each commit to actually selecting 15 tons when you make your private choice? Jack and Emma, would you support the trial by doing the same? Let’s make the quantities explicit now and check the results together afterward.
